clue.text: Entertainer producing terribly ripe rubbish

indicators.note: terribly suggests the word ripe is badly mangled, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: rot is nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: A stage performer whose act is dreadful old rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entertainer' is the definition, and 'terribly' is what turns the word ripe into an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pierrot is a sad clown figure of French pantomime, a traditional stage performer.

clue.text: Plant to make cat smile

indicators.note: to make something of the words cat smile is to rework them, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A garden plant so amusing it gets the cat grinning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make' rearranges the eight letters of CAT SMILE.
explanation.definitionFit: Clematis is a climbing garden plant with large showy flowers.

clue.text: Standard Spanish expression for "word of honour"

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level, as in golf
olé is the Spanish cry of approval

explanation.surface: A Spanish phrase supposedly meaning a promise kept.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole originally meant a prisoner's pledge, his word of honour not to escape.

clue.text: Daily woman with hair like a weed

parts.note: a daily or char is a British cleaning lady who comes in daily
a lock is a tress of hair

explanation.surface: The cleaner's unruly hair is compared to a weed.
explanation.walkthrough: A CHAR is the old British term for a cleaning woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlock is wild mustard, a yellow-flowered weed of fields.

clue.text: Analyse carbon from a great distance

parts.note: to parse a sentence is to analyse its grammar
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: Examining carbon from far away, like a remote chemist.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsec is an astronomical unit of length, about 3.26 light years, so a huge span.

clue.text: Sent as agent and set in action

indicators.note: in places the word for set inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
to put something is to set it down

explanation.surface: Someone dispatched as an agent and put to work.
explanation.definitionFit: To be deputed is to be appointed and sent to act on another's behalf, as a delegate.

clue.text: Sherpa's old vehicle?

definitions.meaning: a Sherpa is a mountain dweller, literally a man of the hills; the 's stands for is
A British car make, now defunct

explanation.surface: A mountain guide's ancient car.
explanation.walkthrough: Hillman cars (such as the Imp) were made in Britain until the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas live in the Himalayas, so one is a hill man; Hillman is also a vanished British car brand.

clue.text: A quiet entertainment outside is less expensive

indicators.note: outside means the word for entertainment wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: cheer is food and drink, hospitable entertainment
p, piano, is the musical mark for quiet

explanation.surface: A muted show around the place costs less.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheaper is the comparative of cheap, meaning lower in cost.

clue.text: Obstruct landlord, perhaps, in obtaining capital

parts.note: to block is to obstruct
a landlord is one example of a letter, someone who lets property

explanation.surface: Thwarting a landlord in order to raise money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks financial but means a capital letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Block letters are plain capitals, as written on forms.

clue.text: Game that brings credit to pulpit

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
an ambo is a raised pulpit or reading desk in early churches

explanation.surface: A pastime that brings honour to the preacher's stand.
explanation.definitionFit: Crambo is an old parlour game in which players find rhymes for a given word.

clue.text: Bird with urge to find flower

parts.note: a lark is a songbird
to spur is to urge on

explanation.surface: A bird keen to find a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Larkspur is a garden plant with spikes of blue flowers, a delphinium.

clue.text: Young man inexperienced with a gun

definitions.meaning: a raw young novice, as in a junior sports player

explanation.surface: A green young fellow holding a firearm.
explanation.definitionFit: A colt is a young male horse, hence a raw youngster; Colt is also a classic American pistol brand.

clue.text: Invaded cache or den, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the words cache or den could become something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hidden store or lair was broken into.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges the ten letters of CACHE OR DEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To encroach is to intrude on another's territory, so encroached means invaded.

clue.text: Play up your street?

definitions.meaning: a British idiom meaning suited to your taste

explanation.surface: A drama that suits you perfectly.
explanation.definitionFit: As You Like It is a Shakespeare comedy, and the phrase also means just to your liking.

clue.text: Material causing publication to give up

parts.note: an organ is a newspaper or journal speaking for a group
to die is to give up the ghost

explanation.surface: Some cloth that makes a newspaper fold.
explanation.definitionFit: Organdie is a fine, stiff, translucent cotton fabric.

clue.text: Child wandered about and felt better

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
roved means wandered about

explanation.surface: A youngster wandered around and recovered.
explanation.definitionFit: To have improved in health is to have got or felt better.

clue.text: Welsh lake not about to become a much larger one

parts.note: Bala is the largest natural lake in Wales

indicators.note: about tells us the word not is turned round

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Welsh lake grows into a far bigger one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns NOT into TON. Balaton in Hungary is central Europe's largest lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition stands for a lake far bigger than Bala: Balaton, Hungary's great inland sea.

clue.text: An inactive coach?

definitions.meaning: someone dormant, such as an agent waiting to be activated

explanation.surface: A coach that is not doing anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeper agent lies idle until called on, and a sleeper is also a train car with berths.

clue.text: Players I kept in and chastised

parts.note: the cast are the actors in a production
gated is British school slang for confined to college as a punishment

explanation.surface: Actors and I were confined and punished.
explanation.walkthrough: GATED is British school and university slang for being kept in as a punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To castigate is to rebuke or punish severely, so castigated means chastised.

clue.text: Material found by model in bathroom

parts.note: toile is a linen or cotton fabric
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: Fabric found beside a fashion model in a washroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A toilet, the room with a lavatory, is often called a bathroom in the US.

clue.text: Girl heard in a monk's bedroom ?

indicators.note: heard signals that a word is spoken, giving its sound

parts.note: a daughter is a girl child

explanation.surface: A young woman's voice is heard in a monastery sleeping quarters.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent DAUGHTER sounds like DORTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A dorter is the dormitory of a medieval monastery, where the monks slept.

clue.text: Head to ask for views

definitions.meaning: an old word for the head
to ... people is to survey their opinions

explanation.surface: A chief who canvasses opinions.
explanation.definitionFit: Poll once meant the top of the head, and to poll is to survey people's opinions.

clue.text: Card game played in the theatre?

definitions.meaning: a solitaire card game for one player
the title of a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera

explanation.surface: A game of cards staged on a theatre set.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience is the British name for solitaire, and also a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.

clue.text: Acted without restraint when young rowdy goes to city abroad

indicators.note: goes to puts the rowdy after the city

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian city
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth tough

explanation.surface: A hooligan running riot on a trip to a foreign city.
explanation.walkthrough: TED is short for Teddy boy, a rowdy British youth of the 1950s.
explanation.definitionFit: To riot is to behave wildly and violently, so rioted means acted without restraint.

clue.text: See letter by essayist on flower

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look or see
B is a letter of the alphabet
Elia was the pen name of essayist Charles Lamb

explanation.surface: Reading a letter from a writer about a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Lobelia is a garden bedding plant with small blue flowers.

clue.text: Erased document about the French model

indicators.note: about means the word for document goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a deed is a legal document
le is French for the
the Model T was Ford's car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: A paper about a French model is wiped out.
explanation.definitionFit: To delete is to remove or wipe out, so deleted means erased.
